description: Amendments to planning permission dated 17th December 2021 (RN 20/04966/FULL) for the Demolition of existing building, extension of existing basement and erection of a new building of ground, mezzanine, plus up to fourteen-storeys with terraces at tenth to fourteenth floor level, comprising office accommodation; flexible retail, restaurant, bar, community and leisure uses; internal pedestrian route with 'Village Square', plant at main roof level; servicing, cycle parking and highways, landscaping and associated works. NAMELY, Updating drawings to align with approved public realm design; revised terrace planters, balustrades, access gates and PV configuration; amendments to terrace door swing directions; roof plant-enclosure steelwork; updates to the GA Elevations to reflect revised louvre extents, changes to opening windows and the addition of a plant-room access door; and amendments to the GA Sections showing the as-constructed fish-belly beam structure.
